messages:
maria_cs: heads up — AcmeForms renewal ~45d out. Usage down ~42% last 30d, monthly active seats dropped from 210 -> 122. Champion (sam foster) left last week :worried:

ops-bot: Usage alert for acct_acmeforms: -42% 30d vs baseline. Triggered at 3181234550.

sara_ae: thanks. who is now the point of contact? any open tickets?

devon_se: we have an onboarding checklist still at 60% (most tasks stalled at 'integration validation'). Last activity by sam on 3181234400.

maria_cs: new PM is listed as "L. Ramirez" in Okta but hasn’t completed onboarding. No active POC threads.

jon_infra: flagged an increase in 429/timeout errors hitting their dedicated endpoint around 3181234200-3181234300 — could explain some of the drop. I can share logs.

sara_ae: @jon_infra please paste the logs or a short pattern. If infra error, we escalate ops + offer credits; if adoption issue, tradecraft is re-engage with features + training.

jon_infra: quick snippet: ```
2026-02-14T16:23:11Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate user_id=acmeforms pid=gw-12
2026-02-14T16:23:12Z ERROR 504 /v1/generate user_id=acmeforms pid=gw-12
```

maria_cs: thx. there's also a competitive signal — heard from exec that "FormLogic" ran a pilot last month. procurement pinged our AE once.

sara_ae: ok — two tracks: (1) ops-reliability fix + tag customer success communications, (2) commercial/retention outreach. I'd like to offer a short remediation pilot / dedicated SE hours.

alex_manager: +1. prioritize ops fix first. If devon can prepare a quick health report and playbook, I'll join the renewal call.

devon_se: I can run a quick health audit and a playbook in ~24h. Action items: collect recent error logs (jon), validate integration steps (maria), confirm current champions/contact (sara).

maria_cs: assigning: jon -> error log summary by EOD, devon -> health audit draft by tomorrow 3pm PT, sara -> reach out to L. Ramirez and procurement to schedule sync. I'll prep renewal-risk note for account exec and CSM lead. :white_check_mark:

sara_ae: outreach msg draft (short): "Hi L — noticed usage dropped and Sam left. Can we hop on a 30m to review onboarding and any blockers? We can offer SE time to help finish integration." Approve?

devon_se: approve. Add line: "we're also investigating transient gateway errors and will share a remediation plan."

alex_manager: also prepare a small commercial incentive: 2 weeks free dedicated SE + migration credits if they commit to a 6mo renewal. Hold the exact numbers until we know severity.

maria_cs: noted. I'll queue a QBR invite for next week as a placeholder. If ops fix is high priority we do a technical triage call first.

sara_ae: thanks team — next update in this thread after audit/logs. :eyes:

ops-bot: Reminder: create a renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_acmeforms, renewal_45d) — ticket #RW-20260323-77

maria_cs: created SF ticket RW-20260323-77 and linked to internal playbook. Closing loop here for now.
